protocol: Matched mesh-quality chair/bunny piles, jitter 0–10, 360 frames, probes every 5, 5ms idle per frame, 2s idle between processes; one GPU process at a time. Same current measuredFrame instrumentation for both source roots. Alternating variant order by seed. Not timing evidence.
decisionRule: Per scene: failures, count of frame probes >=5mm and median peak must not increase. All seeds retained; no extended failure window.
